topic: success criteria and evidence standards in agent development

snippet: Define unambiguous, robust success criteria: a goal describes what success looks like, and a stop condition describes when to stop trying. A verifiable goal can be confirmed without relying on the agent's own judgment.

title: SkillAxe: Sharpening LLM-Authored Agent Skills Through Evaluation-Guided Self-Refinement
snippet: Self-modifications should be accepted only on measured evidence, using two splits: a held-in split that checks the targeted weakness was resolved, and a held-out split the proposer never sees that checks nothing else regressed.
